notice: INVENTED EXAMPLE, NOT DATA FROM THE STUDY. A fictional greenhouse irrigation controller, written by hand only to try the pipeline.

Irrigation Control: The controller shall open a zone valve when the soil moisture of that zone falls below 30 percent.
The controller shall close a zone valve within 5 seconds of a stop command.
The controller shall limit each irrigation cycle to at most 20 minutes.
Monitoring and Alarms: The controller shall read every soil moisture sensor at least once per minute.
The controller shall raise an alarm when a sensor stops reporting for more than 5 minutes.
